reviews.review:
It will be soon 2 years minus 3 months since they released this game into Early Access and I have no idea what this team is doing honestly. 

I played a good ~50 hours at launch and really liked what I saw and the potential it had so I decided to let the developers cook, since I found that base building was rather lacklustre and needed a lot of work in term of construction options on the technical side.

Noticing that the same studio is about to release a new game called Palworld: Palfarm I figured ohh cool so they must be close to finishing Palworld then, I should boot it up again since it was still installed since purchase. (even though I could count maybe, of the top of my head, 2 or 3 times the game updated since then, maybe I missed some.)

So I start a new game to get the new experience and ~10 hours later I'm really wondering what the hell the devs did this whole time?
-The technical side of base building is still as basic as it was.
-The movement is still basic too, nothing changed there either.
-You can still toss your Pal Spheres by mistake without being able to pick them back up if it didn't hit a Pal to trigger the catch sequence. 
-The Stamina work is still terrible, especially when swimming, you will die even tho you are close to a ledge because you can't climb out (no stamina).
-But they blocked of that stone arc stairway to the beach from starting area with rocks so you can now only climb all to a hole to get to the other side or just climb/jump down to that section of the map.

But they had time to do collabs with Terraria? Why?!
Oh and soon there will be a colab release related to first-person shooter Ultrakill ... ?!

This is not a passion project anymore, if it ever was one, [b]it's just BS[/b].

This is not a review but a call to arms if you believe Nintendo is the parasite it is you will play this game for the sake of the Dev's if the majority of the gaming community believes the freedom of creativity an gaming as a general this is not just about palworld this is about gaming as a whole. copyrights are starting to sound like Salem witch levels of finger pointing. Let games be the definition of true freedom of expression an fun. Gamer's Please wake up an smell the ashes an brimstone around us these triple A companies care only about their image an money.
 
Palworld isn't bring anything new to the table for mechanics, yet it still allows that feel like ARK survival evolved. all an all I think the lawsuit is just showing Nintendo's true stinginess an petty ego.

if you got to sue everyone that tries to flatter you all you will have is potential enemies.
Palworld I give it a cosmic forest amount of respect and say I give it a 19/20 just for being the quarantine game that made me smile again an feel like I could be human again.

this is ADHDCoffee AKA Faith/Hollow signing with extreme advisory.

I did not expect much from this game but it is surprisingly enjoyable. There are tons of games that throw together the same elements that this game has (base building, exploration, zelda elements, light survival), but this is the only few of them that manages to nail the balance perfectly.

Do play it in the coop though, it will be inifinitly more enjoyable.
this game was such a fun game to play both by myself and with freinds
